notes.title: THE GAMEPAD UPDATE!
notes.content:
Major Update:
2 new Gamepad types added.
PS-Type and NT-Type are now selectable 
from the Options menu.
This allows players to play the game with on-screen buttons
matching those of their favourite gamepad!

[img]https://pbs.twimg.com/media/Ewxy3bAXIAMYIHa?format=jpg&name=large[/img]

In-Game buttons will now match your favourite controllers!
Try it this weekend! :D

notes.title: Game-Kun: Input Challenge has launched!
notes.content:
Game-Kun: Input Challenge has finally released! 
Get ready to press buttons like a pro! QTE style inputs await, easy to pick up, difficult to master and hard to put down! Join us on the quest to be best on the Leaderboards!
*30+ Skins to Collect, 20+ Achievements and Steam Leaderboards* All for the price of a coffee to go!
